offering_description.value: Prologis develops, owns, manages and leases warehouses and other logistics facilities for businesses such as retailers and third-party logistics providers. Its teams deliver turnkey warehouse upgrades, equipment, workforce training and energy infrastructure, including community solar and fleet charging. It also develops data centers for hyperscalers, offers real estate investment funds and invests in supply chain technology companies.
